objective: Use one audio completed marker and message-ID receipt, removing playback_sequence from runtime and generated APIs while reserving retired protobuf names and numbers
acceptance_criteria: Only an explicit audio oneof with completed true can close audio playback
One final marker follows all generation, tool continuations, and synthesis audio
No receipt from text completion, payload-less completion, queue gaps, flush, or failure
No late audio can reopen a finalized or flushed message ID
Message lifecycle emits one successful metric and session idle request after accepted playback
Text-only completion remains independent from audio playback
Remove playback_sequence fields and generated accessors; reserve AssistantMessage tag 5 and PlaybackComplete tag 3 and the removed name in both messages
Preserve separately authorized Standard control fixes and unchanged rollout defaults
out_of_scope_paths: Unrelated protobuf sources and generated artifacts
Document-api runtime code outside the listed generated files

ownership.coordinator: Message/session lifecycle, adapter routing, packets, and RFC evidence
ownership.producer_worker: Final generation boundaries in the four assistant executor lanes
ownership.synthesis_worker: Text/TTS finality and watchdog failure handling, no STT edits
ownership.transport_worker: Audio-only final marker and single message-ID callback across transports
ownership.protocol_worker: Only the listed talk-api protobuf source and generated files; generation with bash bin/artifacts-generate.sh
ownership.challenger_and_reviewer: Read-only independent review with report-only artifact ownership

principles: No new protobuf messages, fields, stream methods, generic helpers, or third lifecycle
Reuse the existing ID and audio completed flag
No sequence or timestamp correlation and no duration-based success
Preserve unrelated dirty work and accepted RFC0018 bytes
Remove generated fields only through source changes and the repository generator
risks: Some LLM done events are intermediate model or workflow boundaries
Provider flush completion must not impersonate final message synthesis
Legacy clients may complete on text or queue gaps
Final-marker Send can synchronously receive a callback and then fail
Interruption, mode switch, or timeout can race a queued receipt
Removing generated sequence accessors breaks consumers that still reference them
Old binary fields may decode as unknown while old ProtoJSON sequence properties can fail strict parsing
Generator touches other artifacts; snapshot existing dirty output and exclude unrelated churn
required_tests: Audio-only empty/nonempty final marker; text and absent oneof negative cases
Tool continuation and multiple synthesis requests before one terminal
Duplicate/stale receipts, late audio, and callback-during-Send outcomes
Pause/continue/flush, transport failure, timeouts, mode switch, shutdown
Exactly-once message completion metric and session idle handoff
Reserved descriptor names/numbers, unchanged other tags, old binary unknown-field decode, and removed ProtoJSON property rejection
Build all in-repo consumers without sequence fields or accessors
verification_commands: just agent-finalize with exact changed-file inventory
rollback: Disable callback authority first. Full rollback restores matching pre-removal protobuf, generated APIs, and runtime together; never reuse retired tags for different data. Preserve independent control, queue, and idle-expiry fixes.
